author: John Sevinsky
releaseNotes:
0.1.1 - warn at learn time when a capture contains no IR signal (all timings saturated at 0xFFFF), instead of silently storing a code that transmits but does nothing.

0.1.0 - pre-release. Fork of luckygerbils/hubitat-tuya-zigbee-ir adding support for the battery-powered ZG-IR01: fixes IR sending on firmware that does not echo the hub-assigned sequence number, adds a device fingerprint for auto-detection, and exposes temperature, humidity and battery.
